cards.note: No named import from @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives anywhere in src or package.json; the browser half vendors its own glyphs (src/client/icons.tsx copies the SVG paths), so the *16 -> *Regular/*Medium export rename cannot hit it.

No workspaceFiles Remote or service call anywhere in src: the hub reads skills from ctx.skills and its own skillfs; the only workspace read is the storages/workspace.json file, whose table shape is unchanged at 0.1.7.

ctx.settings.register/settingsScope retired: the card's fields are declared on the plugin's own volatile Config (src/index.ts:49/73), settings writes go through ctx.settings.mutate (src/index.ts:173), the browser card binds ctx.configForms.get('skill-hub') (src/client/index.tsx:93), and values the host's one-time settings.yaml import cannot map (namespace dsh-skill-hub != entry skill-hub) are recovered by src/legacy-config.ts and written once via ctx.settings.update (src/index.ts:297).

The plugin ships no agent presets and authors none in the legacy preset directory; preset mentions are comments about preset-owned skill discovery, which the global provider intentionally does not duplicate.

Condition (direct raw-log parsing) is not met: stats read SessionEvent[] through the host sessionQuery/sessionPersistence seams (src/stats/persistence.ts), whose 0.1.7 type surface is unchanged, so V4 stays a host implementation detail.
The bundle patch inserts one bare plugin row (skill-hub) and configures no LLM provider, so the removed DeepSeek protocol key cannot be present.

No-reload fields declared: every editable Config field is .volatile() (src/index.ts:73) and the running host re-reads them and re-syncs on loader/volatile-update (src/index.ts:252), so card edits commit without a remount; the bundle patch stays a single ordered file (package.json dsh.bundle.patch) because it does not need splitting.

Informational: no plugin action. Because an unreadable bundle now loads as MISSING instead of aborting the profile, the migration verified the row is present and activated on a real 0.1.7-alpha.1 boot (GET /api/skill-hub/config answered 200) rather than assuming a crash-free boot means loaded.

Optional display metadata: the Plugin Manager renders the package name/description today and the plugin carries no local workaround for it, so the additive package.json icon and exported locale/ title-description files are not adopted in this migration.
The plugin stores no attachment payloads in session events; it only counts existing user/message and tool/call events, so no attachment carrier moves out of the export path.

The plugin extends the settings panel through settings.section only; it neither contributes the sidebar account launcher nor the Models sign-in step, and it carries no workaround those seats would replace.
